name: Sleep-EDF
description: A collection of polysomnographic sleep recordings, including EEG and other physiological signals, with annotations used for sleep-stage scoring. The Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset contains overnight recordings from healthy subjects and people with mild difficulty falling asleep.
citation: Kemp, B., Zwinderman, A. H., Tuk, B., Kamphuisen, H. A. C., & Oberye, J. J. (2000). Analysis of a sleep-dependent neuronal feedback loop: the slow-wave microcontinuity of the EEG. IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering, 47(9), 1185–1194. https://doi.org/10.1109/10.867928
